utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I meant to bring my drill and then completely spaced it, sorry about that.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No worries, Oren. We can still make use of whatever you’ve got when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rey. I’ll grab what I can find and head over in a few minutes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit behind, but I can check what needs doing and help out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Noah — that’d help a lot. I’ll let everyone know you’re checking what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’ll take a look and see what’s still needed. I might need a quick reminder if I miss anything, but I’m on it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Uli, did the repair drive get the parts list sorted yet?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Not yet — I’m still sorting through it, sorry. I’ll bring you the list as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, thanks. Can you let me know when you’ve got it sorted?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to send you the details? It’d be great to have you there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please send them over — I’ll keep an eye out and mark the location and time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the location, time, and a quick rundown so you’ve got everything handy. Really glad you’re coming!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive, Hana. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam—could you first confirm what tools you have and when you’re free? Then I’ll tell you the next step.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ve got a basic toolbox, a drill, and a ladder, and I’m free this afternoon after 3.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll put together a simple sign-up sheet, line up a few tools, and we can start with the broken bikes and loose fence panels.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, that sounds solid. I can help check the bikes and gather the tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m getting the repair drive organized and I’ll keep you posted on what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, Rosa — just let me know what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I may ask you to help with a few pickups or notices once I’ve got the list sorted.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but only if we can keep the route simple and the timing tight—I’d feel better with the details sorted first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Absolutely — let’s keep it straightforward: one route, set times, and no extra stops. I’ll write it out clearly so we both know what to expect.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good to me—please send the route and timing, and I’ll confirm once I can see the schedule clearly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet, but I can ask around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I’d really appreciate that. I’ve only been getting bits and pieces, so any update helps.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll ask around and let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring over the spare tape and a couple of screwdrivers for the repair drive. Let me know what else we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks—can you confirm the screwdrivers are Phillips and flathead? I want to make sure we’re not missing anything else.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes—I've got one Phillips and one flathead. I’ll do a quick check for any other missing supplies and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Jules—I've got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s awesome, Gus — thank you! I’ll make a quick list and bring by what we need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—bring the list by anytime, and I’ll set the tools aside for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school pickup window—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, thanks — it’s looking like late afternoon, around 4:30 if that still works for the pickup crowd.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4:30 should work—I can shift pickup and let the other parents know. Just send me the final details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time are they thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great — I’m thinking late Saturday morning, maybe around 10, so it doesn’t clash with school runs. If that works, I can confirm it with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 10 sounds good to me—I should be free after the morning school run. Go ahead and confirm it with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, what do you need help fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina — can you tell me exactly what kinds of repairs the drive is collecting for, and whether they need anything specific right now?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I’m checking what repairs the drive is covering and if they need any specific items right now.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, still on for today — I haven’t heard any changes. I’ll let you know if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. I’ll plan on it unless you hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’ve got the repair drive list organized and ready to go. Want me to walk you through what still needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes please — give me the rundown and I’ll check what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — we still need a couple volunteers for the porch railing, one person for the leaky faucet, and anyone who can bring a drill would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can bring it by, just not all at once. I’ll see what I can manage for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Uli — bring what you can, whenever you can. I’ll sort it out from there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, I’ll do my best and drop some off soon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is moving along nicely — I’m still catching up on the details, though. If you’ve got the latest, I’d love to hear it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think it’s going well, though I’d have to check the exact details—my memory’s a bit foggy today. I can ask around and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — I’m mostly just trying to keep up with what’s going on.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in — just send me the repair drive details and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’ll grab the repair drive details and send them over in a sec.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll watch for it and keep it quick on my end.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Happy to help with the repair drive, Sam—what needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara — first we should sort the list of repairs and see what tools or supplies we need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’ll help sort the repair list and match it with the tools and supplies we need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, definitely—I'll pass the word around right away and make sure folks know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate you spreading the word. If anyone needs a hammer, drill, or wrench, just send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll let everyone know you’ve got tools on hand, too. That should make it easier for folks to show up and help out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going so far?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No worries—it's going smoothly so far, and I’ve got the drop-off table set up by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’s great to hear—do you need me to help sort or carry anything?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good to hear the repair drive is moving along — I was just out running errands and noticed a few folks asking about it. If you need anything dropped off or picked up, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that. I’ll let you know if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’m around this afternoon if anything needs ferrying over. Hope the drive keeps picking up momentum.
